about: Tasks BenchFlow refuses before the agent's turn, unscored, for every agent (benchflow.task.refused_tasks). Each entry is keyed by benchmark, task id (the task folder's name) and BenchFlow's task digest (benchflow._utils.task_authoring.task_digest): a task with any byte changed has another digest and runs.
